*This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Problem Statement

Existing Wake traits expose tab activity and health, but Byobu and psmux tab bars do not project that information. Operators must inspect tabs individually and cannot safely toggle a unified visual policy.

## Solution

One WSL-hosted Wake authority projects compact type/profile/activity badges and state-sensitive highlights onto owned Byobu/tmux and Windows psmux tabs. Provide persistent controls and exact one-command rollback/re-enable without restarting sessions.

## User Stories

1. As an operator, I want tab type badges so that I can distinguish stock Codex, modded Codex, Grok, SSH and mixed tabs.
2. As an operator, I want type/activity colours so that I can skim my workspace.
3. As an operator, I want fresh errors to override warnings and waiting so that urgent problems stand out.
4. As an operator, I want selection to remain obvious so that I know where keyboard input goes.
5. As an operator, I want compact profile/activity labels preserving manual names so that tabs stay readable.
6. As an operator, I want optional model/provider details so that I can inspect reported inference identity.
7. As an operator, I want mixed-pane attention aggregation so that one troubled pane remains visible.
8. As an operator, I want unknown health shown honestly so that ordinary shells are not called unhealthy.
9. As an operator, I want automatic updates and stale indications so that dead monitoring cannot look current.
10. As an operator, I want rendering without probes or model work so that redrawing is cheap and passive.
11. As an operator, I want global/workspace opt-outs so that I control decoration.
12. As an operator, I want manual styling to pause decoration so that Wake does not fight my theme.
13. As an operator, I want reconnect/restart persistence so that display policy survives ordinary use.
14. As an operator, I want one-command rollback restoring original settings so that experimentation is reversible.
15. As an operator, I want one-command re-enable retaining my policy and original baseline so that switching is easy.
16. As an operator, I want exact restoration of absent/inherited/explicit options so that rollback preserves my configuration.
17. As an operator, I want restoration failures reported and retryable so that partial rollback is not hidden.
18. As an operator, I want CLI/API/MCP parity so that any controller can operate the feature.
19. As an operator, I want one WSL service for Byobu/tmux and psmux so that both environments share authority.
20. As an operator, I want colour-independent text fallbacks so that unsupported terminals remain usable.
21. As an operator, I want future Claude/custom harness, model and Ollama dimensions represented separately so that future adapters fit without false capability claims.
22. As an operator, I want stock Codex, conversations, processes and tab placement preserved so that decoration causes no workflow interruption.

## Implementation Decisions

- Extend existing controller tab operations and typed terminal adapters; share policy, projection and durable restoration ownership. No arbitrary shell formatting operation.
- CLI command family: `codex-wake tabs format` with status, enable, pause, resume, rollback, reenable, reset, inspect and configure. Equivalent registered API/MCP operations; normal command registry drives help/completion.
- Preserve names, ordering, drafts, native sessions and stock executable. No provider/model work, tab movement or agent restart.
- Type/activity base palette: stock Codex blue, modded teal, Grok violet, SSH steel; fresh error red > health warning magenta > waiting amber > base. Entirely stale neutral grey; independent stale traits cannot suppress fresh errors. Keep type badge and native current-window cue (bold/underline or supported independent equivalent).
- Compact default type/profile/activity/existing name. Optional model/provider display/rules, per-pane details on demand. Harness, build, profile, model, inference provider and execution host are distinct. Configured is not observed. Unknown capabilities remain unknown; legacy provider fields retain semantics.
- Mixed panes: mixed badge and highest-priority fresh attention. Reliable events update immediately; bounded polling around five seconds and stale threshold twenty seconds. Expiry still functions after Wake loss, without shell/probe/model work during rendering.
- Auto decorate owned tabs with global/workspace opt-out. Manual affected-style edits pause decoration in that scope until explicit resume; observations continue. Manual renaming remains supported. Reconnect/restart preserves policy and manual holds.
- Capture original managed option values before first write, including explicit/unset/inherited state, scoped to backend namespace identity. Persist baseline before mutation; never overwrite it on refresh/restart/re-enable. Manage only affected settings.
- Rollback is one command: disable auto reapplication and restore exact original values, even subsequent manual edits of affected options. Automatic cleanup instead preserves manual edits. Read back restoration, report partial failures and missing baselines, permit safe retries. Re-enable is one command applying saved display policy without replacing original baseline. No service restart or manual config editing.
- Capability-aware supported colours/plain-text fallbacks. One WSL authority first; Windows-native service remains future scope.

## Testing Decisions

- Primary seam is the existing public controller operation contract exercised through CLI/API/MCP and real terminal adapters. Assert external results, persisted state across processes and terminal option readback rather than internal call choreography.
- Existing tab lifecycle/contract/monitor tests and disposable installed-backend acceptance are prior art.
- Verify exact baseline restoration, inherited/unset options, repeated rollback/re-enable, partial failure/retry, stale namespace refusal and process continuity.
- Verify fresh precedence, mixed panes, uncertainty, manual override, reconnect, daemon failure expiry, selection, escaping, width and fallback on installed Byobu/tmux and psmux in owned namespaces.
- Run local Python 3.11/3.12 release gates; no paid hosted CI. Never claim fixture tests prove native rendering.

## Out of Scope

Windows-native service deployment; new Claude/custom harness control adapters or model servers; provider calls; model/GPU work; physical grouping/movement; production deployment or theme changes during implementation acceptance.
